_comment_whitelist: These apps are never throttled, even when not in focus. Names as shown in Activity Monitor.
_comment_cpu: A background app is only touched when it uses more than this % of CPU.
_comment_report: A report is requested once the incident is N minutes old AND memory is back to normal.
_comment_cooldown: Protects your subscription limits: at most one Claude request every N minutes.
_comment_renice: renice can lower priority without root, but restoring it needs root. Off by default.
_comment_notify: notify_before_action: one notification per incident when priorities are lowered. notify_every_throttle: one per app (noisy). notify_lag_warning: early warning at the memory warning level.
_comment_confirm: confirm_before_throttle: ask before lowering the priority of each new app. The answer is remembered until the daemon restarts.
_comment_confirm_mode: dialog - centre-screen window with buttons (the only centred window in the program). banner - confirm by clicking a system notification, works only with visible_mode=banner.
_comment_visible: visible_mode: panel - own small window in the top right corner (never takes focus, macOS does not hide it). banner - standard macOS notifications. dialog - centre-screen window.
_comment_critical: critical_alert_mode: dialog - critical events (memory at the limit, system error) are shown as a window. notification - banner and sound only.
_comment_claude_bin: Full path is filled in by install.sh.
_comment_sound: Notification sound. Names from /System/Library/Sounds (Submarine, Basso, Hero, Glass, Ping...). Empty string = silent.
